# Function to create a single edge block
create_edge_block <- function(edge_index) {
  start_v <- graphFEM$E[edge_index, 1]
  end_v   <- graphFEM$E[edge_index, 2]
  
  # Get edge data (assuming edge_index corresponds to the same index in edge_groups)
  edge_data <- edge_groups[[edge_index]]
  
  # Create NA row matching the number of columns
  na_row <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(on_vertex)))
  colnames(na_row) <- colnames(on_vertex)
  
  # Combine: start vertex, edge, end vertex, NA
  rbind(on_vertex[start_v, ],
        edge_data,
        on_vertex[end_v, ],
        na_row)
}

# Apply for all edges and combine
final_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(graphFEM$E)), create_edge_block))

final_data$trueEdge <- cumsum(is.na(final_data$x)) + 1
final_data$trueEdge[is.na(final_data$x)] <- NA

final_data$trueDist <- rep(c(linear_mesh, NA), graphFEM$nV)

r_bridge <- function(t1, t2, kappa, alpha, sigma, ell){
  nu <- alpha - 1/2
  r1_t1_0 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = t1, t = 0, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)[1,]
  r1_t1_ell <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = t1, t = ell, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)[1,]
  
  r_0_0 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = 0, t = 0, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  r_0_ell <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = 0, t = ell, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  r_ell_0 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = ell, t = 0, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  r_ell_ell <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = ell, t = ell, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  
  r1_0_t2 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = 0, t = t2, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)[1,]
  r1_ell_t2 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = ell, t = t2, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)[1,]
  
  r1_h <- matrix(c(r1_t1_0, r1_t1_ell), nrow = 1, ncol = 2*alpha)
  r1_v <- matrix(c(r1_0_t2, r1_ell_t2), nrow = 2*alpha, ncol = 1)
  
  cov <- matern.covariance(h = t1 - t2, kappa = kappa, nu = nu, sigma = sigma) - r1_h %*% solve(rbind(cbind(r_0_0, r_0_ell), cbind(r_ell_0, r_ell_ell)), r1_v)
  return(as.numeric(cov))
}
S_e <- function(t, kappa, alpha, sigma, ell){
  nu <- alpha - 1/2
  r1_t1_0 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = t, t = 0, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)[1,]
  r1_t1_ell <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = t, t = ell, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)[1,]
  
  r_0_0 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = 0, t = 0, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  r_0_ell <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = 0, t = ell, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  r_ell_0 <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = ell, t = 0, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  r_ell_ell <- sigma^2*matern.p.joint(s = ell, t = ell, kappa = kappa, p = 0, alpha = alpha)
  
  r1_h <- matrix(c(r1_t1_0, r1_t1_ell), nrow = 1, ncol = 2*alpha)
  
  cov <- r1_h %*% solve(rbind(cbind(r_0_0, r_0_ell), cbind(r_ell_0, r_ell_ell)))
  return(cov)
}
Sigma_bridge <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(linear_mesh), ncol = length(linear_mesh))
for (i in 1:length(linear_mesh)) {
  for (j in 1:length(linear_mesh)) {
    Sigma_bridge[i,j] = r_bridge(t1 = linear_mesh[i], t2 = linear_mesh[j], kappa = kappa, alpha = alpha, sigma = sigma, ell = ell)
  }
}

final_data$indSample <- NA

# loop over blocks (ignoring NA separators)
blocks <- split(seq_len(nrow(final_data)), final_data$trueEdge)

for (b in names(blocks)) {
  if (is.na(b)) next
  
  idx <- blocks[[b]]
  
  # extract noise vector for this block
  v <- final_data$noise[idx]
  
  #if(b%in%c(3,4,5)) v <- rev(v)
  
  # apply transformation
  res <- as.vector(t(R) %*% v)
  
  # store back
  final_data$indSample[idx] <- res
}
final_data$residual <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(final_data)), function(i) {
  e <- final_data$trueEdge[i]
  t <- final_data$trueDist[i]
  
  # Handle NA rows
  if (is.na(e) || is.na(t)) return(NA)
  
  s0 <- final_data$sample[!is.na(final_data$trueEdge) & final_data$trueEdge == e & final_data$trueDist == 0]
  s1 <- final_data$sample[!is.na(final_data$trueEdge) & final_data$trueEdge == e & final_data$trueDist == 1]
  
  # If endpoints not found, return NA
  if (length(s0) == 0 || length(s1) == 0) return(NA)
  
  
  as.numeric(S_e(t =t, kappa = kappa, alpha = alpha, sigma = sigma, ell = ell) %*% c(s0[1], s1[1]))
})

offset <- ell/4

FINAL_DATA <- final_data %>%
  mutate(
    x0 = x,
    y0 = y,
    x1 = case_when(
      trueEdge == 1 ~ x + 0*offset,
      trueEdge == 2 ~ x + 1*offset,
      trueEdge == 3 ~ x + 0*offset,
      trueEdge == 4 ~ x - 1*offset,
      trueEdge == 5 ~ x - 1*offset,
      TRUE ~ x
    ),
    y1 = case_when(
      trueEdge == 1 ~ y - 1*offset,
      trueEdge == 2 ~ y + 0*offset,
      trueEdge == 3 ~ y + 1*offset,
      trueEdge == 4 ~ y + 0*offset,
      trueEdge == 5 ~ y - 2*offset,
      TRUE ~ y
    )
  )

t_switch <- 0.5

n_frames <- 51
t_vals <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_frames)


ANIM <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(t_vals), function(i) {
  t <- t_vals[i]
  
  FINAL_DATA %>%
    mutate(
      frame = i,
      
      # BLUE (target)
      x_blue = x0,
      y_blue = y0,
      z_blue = sample,
      
      # RED geometry (moving → lock)
      x_move = if (t <= t_switch)
        (1 - t / t_switch) * x1 + (t / t_switch) * x0
      else x0,
      
      y_move = if (t <= t_switch)
        (1 - t / t_switch) * y1 + (t / t_switch) * y0
      else y0,
      
      # RED values
      z_red = if (t <= t_switch) {
        indSample
      } else {
        s <- (t - t_switch) / (1 - t_switch)
        (1 - s) * indSample + s * sample
      },
      
      # 🟢 GREEN geometry (same base as BLUE)
      x_green = x0,
      y_green = y0,
      
      # 🟢 GREEN vertical motion (starts above, drops)
      z_green = if (t <= t_switch) {
        # start above envelope and descend
        z_offset <- max(abs(c(sample, indSample, substracted)), na.rm = TRUE)
        z_start  <- substracted + z_offset
        
        (1 - t / t_switch) * z_start + (t / t_switch) * substracted
      } else {
        # after meeting → collapse into BLUE
        s <- (t - t_switch) / (1 - t_switch)
        (1 - s) * substracted + s * 0
      }
    )
}))

VERT_ANIM <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(t_vals), function(i) {
  t <- t_vals[i]
  
  VERTICES %>%
    mutate(
      frame = i,
      
      # BLUE fixed
      x_blue = x0,
      y_blue = y0,
      
      # RED moves then locks
      x_red = if (t <= t_switch)
        (1 - t / t_switch) * x1 + (t / t_switch) * x0
      else x0,
      
      y_red = if (t <= t_switch)
        (1 - t / t_switch) * y1 + (t / t_switch) * y0
      else y0
    )
})) %>% bind_rows()

  line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.5),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  add_trace(
  data = SEG_GREEN %>% filter(frame <= t_switch * n_frames),
  x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
  frame = ~frame,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.5),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  # RED BASE (moving rigid platform)
add_trace(
  data = ANIM,
  x = ~x_move,
  y = ~y_move,
  z = ~0,
  frame = ~frame,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "black", width = 7),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  # BLUE (always)
add_trace(
  data = VERT_ANIM,
  x = ~x_blue, y = ~y_blue, z = 0,
  frame = ~frame,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(color = "black", size = 7),
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>

# RED (only moving phase)
add_trace(
  data = VERT_ANIM %>% filter(frame <= t_switch * n_frames),
  x = ~x_red, y = ~y_red, z = 0,
  frame = ~frame,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(color = "black", size = 7),
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  config(mathjax = 'cdn') |>
  layout(
    font = list(family = "Palatino Linotype"), # Palatino Linotype
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 0),
    
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = list(text = TeX("x"), font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16),  range = x_range),
              yaxis = list(title = list(text = TeX("y"), font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16), range = y_range),
              zaxis = list(title = list(text = TeX("z"), font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16), range = z_range),
      
      aspectratio = list(x = x_asp, y = y_asp, z = 2),
      
      camera = list(
        eye = list(x = 1*eyer, y = -1*eyer, z = 1.5*eyer),
        center = list(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
  legend = list(
    x = 0,
    y = 0.9, # default = 1
    xanchor = "left",
    yanchor = "top",
    font = list(size = 26),
    tracegroupgap = 0
  )
)

save_dual_for_presentation(p_bridge)
get_frame_plot <- function(k, OFFSET = 0) {
  ANIM_k      <- ANIM      %>% filter(frame == k)
  SEG_BLUE_k  <- SEG_BLUE  %>% filter(frame == k)
  SEG_RED_k   <- SEG_RED   %>% filter(frame == k)
  SEG_GREEN_k <- SEG_GREEN %>% filter(frame == k)
  SEG_ENV_k   <- SEG_ENV   %>% filter(frame == k)
  VERT_ANIM_k      <- VERT_ANIM %>% filter(frame == k+OFFSET)
   
  
  colaxnn <- "gray"
eyer <- 2.7  # 1.5 for presentation 2.7


 
  p_bridge_k <- plot_ly() |>
  
  # base plane
  add_trace(
    data = ANIM_k,
    x = ~x_blue, y = ~y_blue, z = ~0,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "black", width = 7),
    opacity = 1,
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  
  # BLUE (stationary target)
  add_trace(
    data = ANIM_k,
    x = ~x_blue, y = ~y_blue, z = ~z_blue,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "green", width = 7),
    opacity = 1,
    name = sprintf("$\\mbox{Whittle-Matern }u(s)$"),
    legendgroup = "target",
    showlegend = TRUE
  ) |>
  
  # RED (moving → morphing)
  add_trace(
  data = ANIM_k,
  x = ~x_move,
  y = ~y_move,
  z = ~z_red,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "blue", width = 7),
  opacity = 1,
  name = sprintf("$\\mbox{bridge }\\sum_{e\\in\\mathcal{E}}\\widetilde{u}_{B_{\\ell_e}^{\\alpha}}(s)$"),
  legendgroup = "moving",
  showlegend = TRUE
) |>
  add_trace(
  data = ANIM_k,
  x = ~x_green,
  y = ~y_green,
  z = ~z_green,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "rgb(230, 185, 80)", width = 7),
  opacity = 1,
  name = sprintf("$\\mbox{residual }\\sum_{e\\in\\mathcal{E}}\\mathbf{S}_e(s)\\mathbf{D}_e\\mathbf{U}\\;\\;.$"),
  legendgroup = "moving",
  showlegend = TRUE
) |>
  # vertical segments (must use same geometry as blue anchor)
  add_trace(
  data = SEG_BLUE_k,
  x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.5),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  add_trace(
  data = SEG_RED_k,# %>% filter(frame <= t_switch * n_frames),
  x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.5),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  add_trace(
  data = SEG_ENV_k,
  x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.5),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  add_trace(
  data = SEG_GREEN_k,# %>% filter(frame <= t_switch * n_frames),
  x = ~x, y = ~y, z = ~z,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.5),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  # RED BASE (moving rigid platform)
add_trace(
  data = ANIM_k,
  x = ~x_move,
  y = ~y_move,
  z = ~0,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "lines",
  line = list(color = "black", width = 7),
  opacity = 1,
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  # BLUE (always)
add_trace(
  data = VERT_ANIM_k,
  x = ~x_blue, y = ~y_blue, z = 0,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(color = "black", size = 7),
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>

# RED (only moving phase)
add_trace(
  data = VERT_ANIM_k,# %>% filter(frame <= t_switch * n_frames),
  x = ~x_red, y = ~y_red, z = 0,
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(color = "black", size = 7),
  showlegend = FALSE
) |>
  config(mathjax = 'cdn') |>
  layout(
    font = list(family = "Palatino Linotype"), # Palatino Linotype
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 0),
    
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = list(text = TeX("x"), font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16),  range = x_range),
              yaxis = list(title = list(text = TeX("y"), font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16), range = y_range),
              zaxis = list(title = list(text = TeX("z"), font = list(color = colaxnn, size = 22)),  
                           tickfont = list(color = colaxnn, size = 16), range = z_range),
      
      aspectratio = list(x = x_asp, y = y_asp, z = 2),
      
      camera = list(
        eye = list(x = 1*eyer, y = -1*eyer, z = 1.5*eyer),
        center = list(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
  legend = list(
    x = 0.1,
    y = 0.8, # default = 1
    xanchor = "left",
    yanchor = "top",
    font = list(size = 26),
    tracegroupgap = 0
  )
)
  return(p_bridge_k)
}
bridge_frame1 <- get_frame_plot(1,0)
bridge_frame26 <- get_frame_plot(26,1)
bridge_frame51 <- get_frame_plot(51,0)

save_plotly_figure_fixed(bridge_frame1, dpi = 600, scale = 2, viewer_change = 1)
save_plotly_figure_fixed(bridge_frame26, dpi = 600, scale = 2, viewer_change = 1)
save_plotly_figure_fixed(bridge_frame51, dpi = 600, scale = 2, viewer_change = 1)
